narrative: Argues that the intuitive gap between genuinely feeling something and being functionally identical to something that feels will dissolve as consciousness science matures, just as the caloric/heat distinction dissolved when thermodynamics showed heat simply is molecular motion. The philosophical zombie thought experiment is reframed as a conceptual artifact of a pre-scientific framework, destined to seem as puzzling to future generations as caloric theory seems to us.
